description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterClass, which provides a method to register PHP classes for use within Smarty templates. It includes class registration functionality, error handling, and documentation comments.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterClass
classes.description: A class providing a method to register PHP classes within Smarty templates for use during template rendering.

methods.name: registerClass
methods.description: Registers a PHP class to be used in Smarty templates by associating a class name with a class implementation. Throws an exception if the class does not exist.
